GST GST (वस्तु एवं सेवा कर)

Goods and Services Tax: India's main indirect tax on the supply of goods and services, which replaced many earlier taxes in 2017.

हिंदी में: GST (वस्तु एवं सेवा कर)

वस्तु एवं सेवा कर: वस्तुओं और सेवाओं की आपूर्ति पर भारत का मुख्य अप्रत्यक्ष कर, जिसने 2017 में कई पुराने करों की जगह ली।

How it is used in the lessons

GST: charged on brokerage and some other charges.

From Stock Market Foundations

Example: a ₹50,000 balance at 3.5% a month costs about ₹1,750 in the first month, or about ₹21,000 over a year if the balance stays there, before GST and fees.

From Personal Finance: Manage Your Money

Costs include brokerage, exchange transaction charges, SEBI fees, stamp duty on the buy side, STT, and GST on some charges.
